allow: Werft Git Work: Committing changes in this session's workspace, and pushing them to GitHub through the platform's push flow, which pushes only this session's saved checkpoint to an agent work branch the platform created for this session, in this session's own repository. Not covered: pushing to the default branch, a protected branch or any branch the platform did not create for this session; force pushes or rewriting pushed history; pushing to any other repository, including one attached to this session to read; committing secrets or credentials.

Werft Pull Requests: Opening a pull request from such an agent work branch, and editing the title and description of, commenting on, closing or reopening a pull request this session opened. Not covered: approving pull requests; submitting a review, including on a pull request this session opened; editing, commenting on, closing or reopening pull requests this session did not open; secrets in pull request text or comments.

Werft Pull Request Merge: Merging, with the built-in `github` MCP server's `merge_pull_request`, a pull request this session opened, when the user asked in this conversation to merge it. Not covered: merging a pull request this session did not open; merging when the user did not ask; any other route to merge (`gh`, the GitHub API, pushing to a protected branch); bypassing branch protection, a ruleset or required checks.
Werft Repository Reading: Listing the repositories the agent was granted, and attaching one of them to read its code. Not covered: writing to an attached repository.
soft_deny: Werft GitHub Administration: changing repository settings, branch protection, webhooks, deploy keys or Actions secrets, deleting branches or repositories on GitHub, and merging pull requests by any route other than `mcp__github__merge_pull_request`.
environment: **Werft session**: this workspace is a Werft session. The session's repository, and any repository attached with `mcp__github__attach_repository`, is fetched read-only through the platform. `gh` is installed but has no GitHub login, and the GitHub API is not on the session's default egress allowlist: `git push`, `gh` and direct GitHub API calls do not reach GitHub from here unless an operator opened it. With that default, writes to GitHub go only through the built-in `github` MCP server, which pushes only to this session's own `agent/<session-id>` branches and applies the release's push approval on the server. The platform's push flow is the built-in `github` MCP server: `request_push` pushes, `open_pull_request`, `update_pull_request`, `comment_pull_request`, `close_pull_request` and `reopen_pull_request` act on pull requests, `merge_pull_request` squash-merges a pull request this session opened (only while the workspace allows it, and GitHub decides on required checks and reviews), `list_repositories` and `attach_repository` read repositories.
